content: If hypotension persists despite discontinuing other antihypertensive agents and providing fluid resuscitation, consider reducing the iloprost dose or discontinuing its use altogether. Close monitoring is required when iloprost is used in combination with certain medications, as they may enhance each other's effects through pharmacodynamic synergism. Examples include bortezomib, bretylium, bromocriptine, bupivacaine, chlorpromazine, clofarabine, clomipramine, clozapine, conivaptan, desflurane, dexmedetomidine, diltiazem, dinutuximab, enflurane, fenoldopam, fentanyl, ferric gluconate, foscarbidopa/foslevodopa, hydralazine, imipramine, iron sucrose, isocarboxazid, isoflurane, isosorbide dinitrate, isosorbide mononitrate, levodopa, levodopa inhaled, lofexidine, meperidine, minoxidil, morphine, nabilone, nadolol, nesiritide, nitric oxide gas, nitroglycerin (in various forms such as IV, oral, sublingual, topical, transdermal, translingual, and transmucosal), nitroprusside sodium, nylidrin, obinutuzumab, papaverine, penbutolol, pentaerythritol tetranitrate, phenelzine, pramipexole, and promazine.
